title: Mr. Emukule Serves the Nation
subtitle: Working Fathers of Soroti
author: Anthony Mwesigwa
description: Follow Mr. Emukule as he serves in the army, protecting his country and his community.
keywords: soldier, army, protection, Uganda, Soroti, family, work, father, service, nation
dedication: For all soldiers who protect our nation and still love their families.
authorBio: Anthony Mwesigwa is a passionate storyteller from Kampala, Uganda, dedicated to creating engaging educational books for young African readers.
backCoverText: What does a soldier do? Join Mr. Emukule as he trains, serves, and protects. A story about duty, sacrifice, and love for country and family.
